title: D-024 B1-follow-up: project statusLine handler + real installed-version fixture (amendment 2)
objective: Owner amendment 2 (source-002-amendment.md, D-024-R129..R138): build the project status-line handler that BOTH writes the sanitized telemetry sidecar AND prints a compact human-readable status row (one feed for Codex monitoring and owner visibility; no competing configurations), reusing the accepted M0-T088 records/sanitization/sidecar/journal - no restart or rebuild of the telemetry architecture. Prove primary statusLine ingestion with a REAL installed-version fixture (live 2.1.220 capture, not docs-derived synthetic alone) before acceptance. Live wiring into .claude/settings.json is an owner-visible step documented in the report, not performed by this task. Record the official documentation URL (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline) and installed-version proof in the verification evidence. subagentStatusLine implementation stays routed to M0-T089; its live canary stays routed to the campaign canary task (D-024-R137). Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R100 + D-024-R131/R132 (requirements explicitly listed in owner directive D-024 amendment 2).
